newsitem.title: CANADA: Air Canada to make fleet announcement.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada to make fleet announcement.

text.p: Air Canada said on Thursday that it expects to make an announcement early on Friday regarding its fleet.
Air Canada spokeswoman Nicole Couture-Simard told Reuters the announcement would be made at 0600 EDT/1000 GMT, but she declined to elaborate.
Analysts said the carrier was expected to announce a plane order valued at up to US$1.4 billion from either Boeing Co or Toulouse, France-based aircraft consortium Airbus Industrie.

Simard said Air Canada was reviewing its fleet requirements, she but declined to specify whether Friday's announcement was a plane order. The fleet announcement would be made separately from the release of Air Canada's second-quarter earnings, also expected on Friday.
On Thursday, Air Canada shares rose 0.40 to 12.05 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on volume of almost 1.5 million shares.
Boeing is an aircraft manufacturer based in Seattle.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Societe Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz AG unit Daimler-Benz Aerospace, and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
